notes:
- Convert Machine Design recovers editable Run, Satin, and Tatami sections where it can verify the conversion. Compare the results side by side, split sections, and resize to regenerate stitches.
- Remove unused thread colors in one step. New design previews use a medium gray background.
- Import supported editable objects from a Hatch 4 e4.5.1 EMB compatibility copy and save changes as a StitchFits project.
- Capture a PNG of the whole design, current window, or a custom area, with an optional transparent background.
- Use Mirror-Copy to place horizontal, vertical, or three mirrored copies in one undo step.
- Create carving stamps on editable Tatami fills. Recovered specialty samples retain supported Motif Fill and carving settings.
